**Decision:** `accept` — recorded by operator.
**Lenses:** `correctness` + `security` — 2 juror(s), one per lens, each a separate `judge` step spawned with its own derived session id (#3028) and its own tools (#3319). They ran SEQUENTIALLY and neither saw the other's findings; this is not a `judgePanel` fan-out (#3050). The other 3 panel lens(es) (simplicity, standards-conformance, claim-accuracy) did NOT run and are not reported as unjudged.
**Earned vs seated:** this PR's code touch-set scores care `elevated` (blast-radius (scripts/lib/pr-view-transport.mjs, scripts/operations/__tests__/review-pr-io.test.mjs, scripts/operations/review-pr-io.mjs, …)), for which the care dial asks for 5 lens(es) × 1 juror(s)/lens × 2 round(s). This run seated 2 lens(es) (correctness, security), 1 juror each, in 1 round. SHORTFALL: 3 earned lens(es) (simplicity, standards-conformance, claim-accuracy) did not sit. The caller declared `--careLevel=elevated`. The shortfall is structural — the step list is fixed at registration (#3319) — so it is RECORDED here rather than implied away: do not read the seats above as the whole review this PR earned.
